gaps.sentence: This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.
